info.name: IEMS DCG Governance Service Demo
info.description: Separate DCG registry/check/dashboard demo. Run setup only against a fresh, isolated service with contracts.validation.strict-mode=false. Run verification against a populated service before and after restart. No reset request is included.

item.name: Register and check (fresh isolated service only)

item.name: Phase 2.2 — isolated failure scenarios
item.description: Run each four-request group only after configuring the specified unavailable endpoint or phase2-rehearsal test-only adapter. Use distinct commitSha values to avoid webhook deduplication. These are not real model predictions.

item.description: Read-only verification after the isolated fault rehearsal. Supply run IDs from private evidence in the environment; this folder does not submit checks or need a model process.
